topic: Why matching their first $20 of earnings changes everything
caption:
The moment your teen earns their first $20 on their own, match it.

That simple move doubles their momentum and tells them you believe in what they're building.

Parents who try this say their teen stops waiting to be told what to do.

copy.headline: Match Their First $20 and Watch Them Change
copy.body: When your teen earns their first $20, match it. That $20 from you turns into $40 they earned together — and suddenly the hustle feels real, worth repeating, and worth their time.
